No borders, grid lines, labels, text, letters, logos or background. Premium polished 3D cartoon arcade props with clean chunky forms, cyan/violet/pink/green/ivory light and graphite details; different easily recognizable silhouettes at 48px. NOT any balloon, anvil, meteor, rocket, cloud with face, magnet or tornado. ROW1 left to right: 1) a lime-cyan glowing energy drink CAN with lightning bolt SHAPE but no writing; 2) a corrupt violet-red GLITCH MICROCHIP surrounded by small offset pixel squares; 3) a white-cyan RESCUE QUADCOPTER DRONE with four compact rotors and a small underside rescue hook, no person; 4) a wide graphite HOVERBOARD with violet rails, magenta side lights and two cyan lift engines underneath, no rider. ROW2 left to right: 5) a circular LASER ELEVATOR EMITTER platform with bright cyan rings and a SHORT vertical light column, no passenger; 6) a black violet broken POWER BATTERY with dim pink indicator segments and one small electric spark, no writing; 7) a heavy violet GRAVITY TRAP CUBE in a pink glowing anti-gravity cage with three short metallic chains below; 8) a silver-cyan EMP ENERGY ORB surrounded by a bright cyan-white electrical ring, not a planet, meteor or fireball. ROW3 left to right: 9) a REBOOT holographic rectangular cyan circuit panel with a central large glowing circular POWER SYMBOL (simple geometric icon, not a word), no swirling portal; 10) a GOLD AND CYAN HOLOGRAPHIC CROWN, three points and tiny magenta gem, standalone no trophy cup; 11) a human street thief VEX's violet HOOD AND MAGENTA LOWER-FACE BANDANA with expressive human eyes and short silver hair, head icon only, no skull or monster; 12) a compact luminous cyan CHECKPOINT BEACON with diamond topper and a check-mark SHAPE on its body, no text. Each sprite centered with identical empty safety margins, clear readable silhouette, maintain real RGBA transparency between and around every sprite. No scenery, no floor shadows, no gradient matte or fake checkerboard.
